mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run (id, post_id, trigger_comment_id, actor_user_id, status, skill_name, reply_comment_id, started_at, finished_at, error_message) VALUES (#{id}, #{postId}, #{triggerCommentId}, #{actorUserId}, #{status}, #{skillName}, #{replyCommentId}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id AS postId, trigger_comment_id AS triggerCommentId, actor_user_id AS actorUserId, status, skill_name AS skillName, reply_comment_id AS replyCommentId, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, error_message AS errorMessage FROM agent_run WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, post_id AS postId, trigger_comment_id AS triggerCommentId, actor_user_id AS actorUserId, status, skill_name AS skillName, reply_comment_id AS replyCommentId, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, error_message AS errorMessage FROM agent_run WHERE trigger_comment_id = #{triggerCommentId}
